digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral in scope inheritance and does not poison sibling path declarations or force whole-HEAD invalidation
Any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance, preventing child paths from being inherited and blocking `all_none` classification
`all_none` classification is true only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated `none`
Mixed-scope container signatures with both `paths` and `none` children must sign only the path child dependencies and survive unrelated file drift
Cheap resign in `resign.py` must preserve the same child-derived signed scope using the immutable relation snapshot without network reads
P9 must pass leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, advise only live undeclared children, and name both path and `--none` as truthful remedies
